title: Go: practical programs, concurrency and Kubernetes controllers
summary: A complete Go learning path from your first compiled program to tested services and Kubernetes controller design. Small offline programs make language rules observable; prepared project chapters explain real integration boundaries.

lessons.title: From source text to a checked Go program
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement from source text to a checked go program.
lessons.lab: Bind greeting to Hello, Go and check its exact text.
lessons.verification: greeting equals Hello, Go. The checked result is amount=24.

lessons.title: Numeric types, constants and explicit conversions
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement numeric types, constants and explicit conversions.
lessons.lab: Compute 7/2 and float64(7)/2.
lessons.verification: The results are 3 and 3.5. The quotient is -3 and the remainder is -1.

lessons.title: Decisions, loops and invariants
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement decisions, loops and invariants.
lessons.lab: Sum 2, 4 and 6 while checking every visited prefix.
lessons.verification: The final sum is 12 and three elements were visited. Exactly 2 values satisfy the predicate.

lessons.title: Functions and value-passing contracts
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement functions and value-passing contracts.
lessons.lab: Implement twice and check inputs 7 and 0.
lessons.verification: The results are 14 and 0. The invalid domain is rejected before returning a usable area.

lessons.title: Arrays, slices and backing-storage ownership
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement arrays, slices and backing-storage ownership.
lessons.lab: Take the first two elements of 1, 2, 3 and change the first through the slice.
lessons.verification: The original first element becomes 9. The original array remains unchanged.

lessons.title: Maps, presence and deterministic ordering
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement maps, presence and deterministic ordering.
lessons.lab: Read present key zero and absent key missing with comma-ok.
lessons.verification: Both values are 0, but only zero is present. The value is 0 and presence is false.

lessons.title: Strings, bytes, runes and Unicode boundaries
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement strings, bytes, runes and unicode boundaries.
lessons.lab: Inspect A followed by a smiling face.
lessons.verification: There are 5 bytes and 2 runes. The result is blue sky.

lessons.title: Structs and explicit domain models
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement structs and explicit domain models.
lessons.lab: Construct Point with X 2 and Y 3 and calculate Manhattan distance from the origin.
lessons.verification: The distance is 5. The empty name is rejected; the valid name is retained.

lessons.title: Pointers, mutation and allocation lifetimes
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement pointers, mutation and allocation lifetimes.
lessons.lab: Create an integer 4 and increment it through a helper receiving its address.
lessons.verification: The caller value becomes 5. The absent call returns false; the present value becomes 8.

lessons.title: Methods, interfaces and the typed-nil trap
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement methods, interfaces and the typed-nil trap.
lessons.lab: Store Counter with value 3 in a Valuer interface.
lessons.verification: Calling Value returns 3. Both implementations can be read through one contract.

lessons.title: Errors as values and preserving causal context
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement errors as values and preserving causal context.
lessons.lab: Wrap ErrMissing with a record-reading context.
lessons.verification: errors.Is still recognizes ErrMissing. Both sentinels remain discoverable.

lessons.title: Defer, cleanup and deliberate panic boundaries
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement defer, cleanup and deliberate panic boundaries.
lessons.lab: Register first and second cleanup markers and return.
lessons.verification: The observed order is second then first. All three markers are present after the loop.

lessons.title: Packages, modules and reproducible project boundaries
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement packages, modules and reproducible project boundaries.
lessons.lab: Join logical slash-separated path segments with path.Join.
lessons.verification: The result is reports/daily.json. The resulting logical name is reports/day-3.json.

lessons.title: Table-driven tests and useful counterexamples
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement table-driven tests and useful counterexamples.
lessons.lab: Test clamp with values below, inside and above the range 0 to 10.
lessons.verification: The outputs are 0, 4 and 10. The result is 10.

lessons.title: Generics and constraints without losing semantics
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement generics and constraints without losing semantics.
lessons.lab: Call first with an integer slice and a string slice.
lessons.verification: The results are 4 and red with presence true. Red and red remain distinct.

lessons.title: Closures, callbacks and controlled iteration
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement closures, callbacks and controlled iteration.
lessons.lab: Create a closure referring to factor, change factor, then call it.
lessons.verification: The closure uses the new factor 3. The collected values are 2 and 4.

lessons.title: Readers, writers and bounded streaming
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement readers, writers and bounded streaming.
lessons.lab: Copy alpha from a strings.Reader into bytes.Buffer.
lessons.verification: Five bytes are copied and output is alpha. The header is AB and payload is xyz.

lessons.title: Filesystems, paths and owned cleanup
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement filesystems, paths and owned cleanup.
lessons.lab: Read data/input.txt containing red and a newline.
lessons.verification: The bytes decode to red followed by a newline. item.txt is readable within the logical subtree.

lessons.title: JSON schemas, strict decoding and unknown input
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement json schemas, strict decoding and unknown input.
lessons.lab: Decode a name and count into Config.
lessons.verification: The fields become sample and 3. JSON syntax is valid but count validation fails.

lessons.title: CSV, record shape and data-quality contracts
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement csv, record shape and data-quality contracts.
lessons.lab: Read name and city where the city is Springfield, West.
lessons.verification: The record contains two fields. The schema order is name then count.

lessons.title: Command-line contracts and configuration precedence
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement command-line contracts and configuration precedence.
lessons.lab: Parse -count=3 with a default of 1.
lessons.verification: The resulting count is 3. The explicit setting wins.

lessons.title: HTTP handlers and in-process service tests
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement http handlers and in-process service tests.
lessons.lab: Send GET /health to the handler.
lessons.verification: The status is 200 and the body is ok plus a newline. The path still matches and returns 200.

lessons.title: HTTP clients, cancellation and response ownership
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement http clients, cancellation and response ownership.
lessons.lab: Use a fake transport returning status 200 and body ready.
lessons.verification: The client helper returns ready without error. The transport helper returns an empty string successfully.

lessons.title: Goroutines and explicit completion
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement goroutines and explicit completion.
lessons.lab: Start a goroutine computing 6 times 7 and receive its result.
lessons.verification: The received value is 42. The sum is 30.

lessons.title: Channels, buffering and close ownership
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement channels, buffering and close ownership.
lessons.lab: Buffer 2 and 3, close and sum the channel.
lessons.verification: Both values arrive and the sum is 5. The received copy stays 1.

lessons.title: Select, contexts and cancellation trees
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement select, contexts and cancellation trees.
lessons.lab: Create a cancelable context and cancel it.
lessons.verification: Err returns context.Canceled. It returns 8 without error.

lessons.title: Mutexes, atomics and shared-state invariants
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement mutexes, atomics and shared-state invariants.
lessons.lab: Run four workers doing 100 protected increments each.
lessons.verification: The joined final count is 400. Both snapshots preserve total 10.

lessons.title: Bounded worker pools and result ordering
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement bounded worker pools and result ordering.
lessons.lab: Square 3, 1 and 2 with two workers.
lessons.verification: The result is 9, 1, 4. One result equals 25 and all workers exit.

lessons.title: The memory model, race diagnosis and publication
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement the memory model, race diagnosis and publication.
lessons.lab: Send an initialized record from a goroutine.
lessons.verification: The reader observes count 3 and ready true. The reader receives ready:3.

lessons.title: Algorithms, benchmarks and allocation-aware design
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement algorithms, benchmarks and allocation-aware design.
lessons.lab: Find the first value at least 5 in 2, 4, 6, 8.
lessons.verification: The index is 2. The first duplicate has index 1.

lessons.title: Structured logging and observable operations
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement structured logging and observable operations.
lessons.lab: Log processed with count 3 and parse its JSON.
lessons.verification: The record has message processed and numeric count 3. The parsed field remains numeric 12.

lessons.title: Security boundaries, escaping and input budgets
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement security boundaries, escaping and input budgets.
lessons.lab: Render script-like text with html/template.
lessons.verification: Angle brackets become escaped text. read is accepted and exec is rejected.

lessons.title: Repository interfaces and transaction failure policy
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement repository interfaces and transaction failure policy.
lessons.lab: Transfer 3 between balances 5 and 5 in a staged transaction.
lessons.verification: The committed balances are 2 and 8. The state is preserved and the operation succeeds.

lessons.title: Build targets, containers and graceful process design
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement build targets, containers and graceful process design.
lessons.lab: Read runtime target identifiers.
lessons.verification: Both identifiers are nonempty. The result is lesson/1.0 revision=abc123.

lessons.title: Kubernetes objects, metadata, spec and status
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement kubernetes objects, metadata, spec and status.
lessons.lab: Decode a fixture requesting 3 replicas with 2 ready.
lessons.verification: Desired is 3 while ready is 2. Only the equal complete state satisfies this simplified predicate.

lessons.title: Labels, selectors and service membership
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement labels, selectors and service membership.
lessons.lab: Match app=web and tier=frontend against a Pod containing both.
lessons.verification: The selector matches. Both versions match the stable app selector.

lessons.title: Reconciliation as an idempotent control loop
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement reconciliation as an idempotent control loop.
lessons.lab: Observe no child for a desired replica count of 3.
lessons.verification: The action is create. The planner requests update, then converges at zero.

lessons.title: Resource versions and optimistic concurrency
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement resource versions and optimistic concurrency.
lessons.lab: Update value 2 using its current token a.
lessons.verification: The value changes and token becomes b. Both attempts conflict and neither changes state.

lessons.title: List-watch continuity, bookmarks and expired history
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement list-watch continuity, bookmarks and expired history.
lessons.lab: Apply ADDED for demo with value 2.
lessons.verification: The cache gains demo=2. An error is returned without accepting invented semantics.

lessons.title: Work queues, retry budgets and error classification
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement work queues, retry budgets and error classification.
lessons.lab: Inspect attempts 0, 1 and 2.
lessons.verification: The delays are 1, 2 and 4 units. Exactly three attempts are admitted.

lessons.title: A real client-go project and explicit cluster configuration
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement a real client-go project and explicit cluster configuration.
lessons.lab: Validate an HTTPS endpoint, lesson namespace and explicit context name.
lessons.verification: The configuration is accepted. The embedded credential form is rejected.

lessons.title: Informer caches, stale reads and safe object copies
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement informer caches, stale reads and safe object copies.
lessons.lab: Copy a cached object and change its app label.
lessons.verification: The cache still contains the original label. The original label count is unchanged.

lessons.title: Finalizers, deletion and exact ownership
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement finalizers, deletion and exact ownership.
lessons.lab: Inspect a normal object without the controller finalizer.
lessons.verification: The next action is add-finalizer. The unrelated entry remains.

lessons.title: Service accounts, RBAC and least-authority controllers
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement service accounts, rbac and least-authority controllers.
lessons.lab: Allow get on pods in the lesson namespace.
lessons.verification: The request is admitted by the local rule model. Only list is admitted.

lessons.title: Leader election, leases and fencing limits
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement leader election, leases and fencing limits.
lessons.lab: Let candidate a acquire at logical time 10 for five units.
lessons.verification: Holder becomes a and expiry 15. No lease is acquired.

lessons.title: Admission decisions, webhook contracts and failure policy
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement admission decisions, webhook contracts and failure policy.
lessons.lab: Validate replica count 3 under maximum 5.
lessons.verification: The decision allows the request. The decision is denied.

lessons.title: Controller tests from pure functions to owned clusters
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement controller tests from pure functions to owned clusters.
lessons.lab: Run a fake client configured to return a value.
lessons.verification: The result is retained and exactly one call occurs. Both identifiers survive comparison.

lessons.title: Capstone: a reliable, resumable controller design
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement capstone: a reliable, resumable controller design.
lessons.lab: Reconcile owned UID u1 from count 1 to desired 3.
lessons.verification: The count becomes 3 with one write. The restarted invocation makes no additional write.
